notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers!



We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for Pizza Slice - our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from August 26th until September 16th. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s Steam Store Page and click the green “Request Access” button to be viable for participation.



It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 



Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy!


[previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube]

🍕About Pizza Slice[hr][/hr][p align="justify"]If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!


Game features:[p align="justify"]The Dream - Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis.

[p align="justify"]The Business - owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.


[p align="justify"]The Buzz - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores.

[p align="justify"]A cozy simulation - the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business.

[p align="justify"]A portion for two - you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! 


🥓What can you expect from the build?[hr][/hr]
A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.



The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.



Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.


🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?[hr][/hr]
We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.



The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. 



If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.



Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.


Build Information & Requirements
Platform: Windows PC via Steam

Controller Support: Partial Support

Supported Languages - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.


Hardware Minimum Requirements:

Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer

Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz

4 GB RAM

Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x

DirectX 11

6 GB free HDD Space

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/5cad23e3d69124a09464eaa373a4ca05d73d1221.png

You’re probably thinking what a horror game is doing in the Sit back and Relax category. We understand your initial skepticism, but hear us out! Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure game at its core - it’s meant to be chill. And we provide chill in spades! Through the chills running down your spine as you make your way through the mansion. Or the laid back kind of chill of not pressing a thousand buttons at the same time but just soaking in the adventure. And lastly, of course, you get the happy chills when you solve that riddle and progress the story. You see, it’s all in the package!

So let us not belay anymore - play and vote! Your support means a lot to us!

notes.title: Atmosphere of the Puppet House
notes.content:
Hi,

Let’s dive deeper into the process of creating the story and atmosphere of Puppet House. It’s time to learn where this horror adventure game draws inspiration from when it comes to its eerie narrative and the chilling ambiance that players will experience. Ready to explore the vibes lurking in Puppet House? Let’s go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/c78f71197f9499f784ff974686f1e37fb46d268e.png

The Escape Room Experience
At its core, Puppet House is a horror game packed with puzzles. We wanted to capture that feeling of being trapped in a maze of rooms, where navigating requires finding keys and specific items to progress. This constant search adds an extra layer of excitement and satisfaction to the looming dread. Oh, and let’s not forget the murderous puppet that’s tailing your every move, turning the entire experience into a deadly escape room challenge.

Old-School Horror Movie Vibes
There’s nothing quite like the eerie atmosphere of classic horror movies on old VHS tapes. The absurdity of those B-movie plots is both scary and funny, even today. That’s the tone we aimed for with Puppet House. Our puppet perfectly captures that strange balance—whether it’s a chilling scare or an unexpectedly goofy moment, you’ll never know if the next scene will make you scream or laugh!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/b7bbeef590d89a5c1a10da19002ec6ffdba70195.png
Exploring Fears
Horror has always been a powerful way to tap into different types of fears we experience. There’s something thrilling about watching your worst nightmares play out in a fictional setting. In Puppet House, we’ve woven these fears into the very fabric of the game—a murderous puppet on the loose, the claustrophobic confines of the house, and the unsettling feeling that you’re always being watched. These elements combine to create an atmosphere thick with dread and tension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House/

The official launch of PC and consoles is coming on October 24th! Make sure to wishlist Puppet House on Steam and prepare for this terrifying adventure.

Playtime’s over,
Gaming Factory

notes.title: Inspirations
notes.content:
Hi,

Puppet House is well underway, and we thought it was time to share a little about what led us to create this spooky, yet not-so-serious, game. Our goal? To weave together an eerie tale brimming with unexpected twists, all wrapped up in the nostalgia of those cheesy-but-chilling campy horror movies. And what is creepier (and funnier) than a puppet that's up to no good?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/399cbebbc3d4ac03fe2748b5fe19fd0354bc8d39.png

There was an idea…
To craft a story set in an abandoned house where players would constantly feel like they’re being watched. Not by a typical horror villain, but by something that really shouldn’t be that terrifying - at least, not at first glance. Enter the puppet. When you meet this unsettling little creature at the start of the game, you might not even feel scared. At first, you may not be scared of your main enemy. But trust us, that false sense of security will vanish very quickly.

The mystery is…
The puppet is alive! We all have that one memory - the first time we saw a creepy, murderous doll in those old VHS horror flicks. Child’s Play, Puppet Master... you knew something was terribly wrong when the ‘innocent’ toy came to life. That’s the exact kind of dread we wanted to capture in Puppet House. You might start off thinking, ‘This little guy isn’t so bad’, but before long, you’ll be rethinking every childhood toy you ever owned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/71421897ccfeff6b1f3bbc0017966b6f3e2610f5.png
People are scared of dolls and puppets because…
There is a concept of them being ‘uncanny’. It’s all about the eerie mix of familiarity and unnaturalness. These figures are meant to look human, but there’s always something off - the blank stares, frozen smiles, and stiff movements. It’s like they’re imitating life, but not quite right, which sets off alarm bells in our brains. 

Add in the idea that they could come to life at any moment, and you've got a recipe for fear. It’s no wonder dolls and puppets have become horror staples - they blur the line between harmless toys and potential nightmares.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House/

Dare to enter Puppet House on October 24th and find out if you can survive the puppet’s deadly game.

Playtime’s over,
Gaming Factory

notes.title: Learn the story of the Puppet House
notes.content:
Hi,

As the release of Puppet House approaches, we delve deeper into its dark narrative. Meet the brave protagonist who will guide you through the scares and puzzles of this horror adventure game. Prepare yourself to uncover the horrifying secrets of Field Town—a place marked by an abandoned house, the mysterious disappearances of residents, and a seemingly innocent puppet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/0d3da6d72dfe980d149cc17db4d8ce65a3a7b999.png

Peter Hill, a once-famous ventriloquist, died under mysterious circumstances, leaving behind a decrepit cabin deep in the forest. This forsaken wooden house, straight out of a nightmare, became the center of gruesome rumors. As curiosity drew the brave—or the foolish—toward it, they sought to unravel the truths hidden within its walls.

Each new disappearance of a Field Town resident only fueled the town's fear, as whispers of terror grew louder. Locals spoke of blood-curdling screams echoing through the forest, emanating from Peter Hill's cursed cabin. These chilling cries were carried through the forest paths, cementing the house's reputation as a place of unspeakable horror.

[previewyoutube=TILKbp5tGOs;full][/previewyoutube]
Rick Evans is a detective known for his peculiar interest in abandoned places. After reading more articles about the ventriloquist’s mysterious house, he resolved to investigate. Little did he know, the horrors awaiting him would be far beyond his darkest nightmares. What ghastly secrets would he unearth in this house of horrors, where the only trace of Peter Hill's existence is a wooden puppet

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House/

Puppet House is a horrifying yet comedic tale that unfolds as you navigate a series of escape room puzzles in a place saturated with sinister forces. Each room is a labyrinth of secrets waiting to be unearthed, steeped in an atmosphere of unrelenting tension and dread. Uncover the truth, survive the night, and try not to lose your sanity as the eerie sound of wooden dolls' footsteps echoes around you.

Look out for the next devlogs and follow our social media for more exclusive content from the game.

Playtime’s over!

notes.title: Enter the world of Puppet House
notes.content:
Welcome, dear Viewers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/d700e06a111c7ae274309e892e68b8abbe83d945.png

My name is Peter Hill, an outstanding ventriloquist! 
You will soon learn my story, although I'm not sure if you are ready...

Dear viewers, you will soon regret that you wanted to know the secrets of my mansion. Everyone in Field Town talked about the place, many of them even tried to get inside. Articles have been written about disappearances and screams coming from the walls of the abandoned house, owned by Peter Hill. However, the secret hidden in that place was still unknown to anyone.

Watch the short teaser and then decide if you are brave enough to risk your life and discover a story that should be forgotten.

[previewyoutube=UdLa--Rw9S0;full][/previewyoutube]
In Puppet House, you will take on the role of Rick Evans, a photographer whose interest in haunted places has directed him inside the gates of my residence. 

Step beyond the threshold of my mansion, where you will hear absolutely nothing but the howl of the wind and the creaking of old boards. This place should be forsaken, yet you will soon realize that you can feel someone's presence there. Puppet House puzzles will keep you in the place of nightmares for a long time, and the further notes and articles you discover will bring you closer to the truth. However, do you want to discover it? Won’t it be too terrifying to uncover?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/14625eeb571ac7530009061acda8ea66d4866838.png
Remember to add Puppet House to your Steam wishlist to not miss any updates. Also, join our Discord where together we can look forward to the grand premiere on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House


Let’s start the show!
Peter Hill
